description: The moon, when near, is a good omen; it predicts fortune. When distant, in exposure of your secrets.
The fish is the emblem of riches through stocks; but if distant, it fortells failure and disaster.
The rapiers warn us against assaults which threaten and will occur sooner or later, according to the distance from the person.
Lightning denotes surprise, dissagreeable in accordance to distance.
The broken glass fortells ill lick for long years if near; but if distant, death of a friend.
The money safe indicates riches; if shut side is toward the person, it denotes loss by speculation.
